note: Fictional initiatives written for this experiment on 2026-11-19. No real organization, person or Certified project is described; any resemblance to a real name is unintended. `facts` stand for what an owner keeps on their own device; `sharedFacts` and entries with `shared: true` stand for what an owner reviewed and shared for matching. `publicWork` stands for a passage on a public project page that nobody confirmed to Weave.

initiatives.name: Riverbend Resilience Hub
initiatives.description: Neighbours in a rural river valley preparing for wildfire and flood. We run resilience workshops with residents, map climate risks street by street and plan climate adaptation projects for our small town.

needs.title: Funding for a two-year wildfire and flood adaptation plan
needs.description: Pay a coordinator, run resident workshops and commission a climate risk assessment for the valley.

needs.title: An adaptation practitioner to lead a grant application with us
needs.description: We are not registered. We need an experienced climate adaptation practitioner who can apply with a community group and administer the award.

offers.title: Resident workshops on climate adaptation
offers.description: We can host and facilitate community workshops in our valley for adaptation planning projects.

initiatives.name: Cascadia Adaptation Practice
initiatives.description: A small nonprofit of climate adaptation planners working with towns and Tribal governments on wildfire, flood and heat plans.

needs.title: Community partners for adaptation planning in small towns
needs.description: We are looking for community groups that can host resident workshops for adaptation planning.

offers.title: Climate adaptation practitioner for community grant applications
offers.description: We are an experienced adaptation practitioner. We can apply as the lead with a community group, write the adaptation plan and administer the award.

initiatives.name: Mill Creek County Resilience Office
initiatives.description: A county office coordinating emergency planning and climate resilience with unincorporated communities.

offers.title: Local government partner for community resilience projects
offers.description: Our county office can join community-led wildfire and climate resilience proposals as the local government partner.

initiatives.name: Cooperativa Terra Aperta
initiatives.description: A social cooperative restoring disused buildings for community use in southern Italy.

offers.title: Third-sector partner for social reuse of community buildings
offers.description: Our cooperative can join partnerships as a third-sector organization and manage the reuse of a building for community benefit.

initiatives.name: Stichting Open Delta
initiatives.description: A Dutch foundation that pairs with community organizations abroad on water and land projects.

offers.title: Dutch partner organization for joint proposals
offers.description: We can submit a proposal jointly as the Dutch partner and raise funds in the Netherlands for a project the local organization owns.

initiatives.name: Kijani Watershed Network
initiatives.description: Farmer groups in western Kenya restoring a watershed with tree nurseries, spring protection and community-led land planning.

needs.title: Funding for three tree nurseries and spring protection
needs.description: Seedlings, fencing and training for farmer groups.

offers.title: Local government partner for community resilience projects
offers.description: Our township can join community-led wildfire and climate resilience proposals as the local government partner.
